name: Jatiya Sangsad
notes: Jatiya Sangsad, 350 seats: 300 directly elected plus 50 reserved for women, shared between parties by their vote and filled by Parliament in April-May 2026. Seats by party from the February 2026 election as the IPU Parline record gives it (BNP 210 after two by-election wins on 9 April, Jamaat-e-Islami 68, National Citizen Party 6, independents 7, other parties 7, two seats vacant because by-elections were postponed) plus the 50 reserved women's seats: 36 to the BNP-led alliance (added to the BNP row), 13 to the Jamaat-led alliance and 1 to independents, as the Election Commission allocated and gazetted them. The split of the 13 between Jamaat-e-Islami, the NCP and its other allies was not confirmed from a final gazette, so they are one row. The parliament's own member list (parliament.gov.bd/sitting-members) returned a 404 page when read on 2026-11-11, so the chart is the published seat distribution with no member named.
